notes: v2.19.0 — Upload Auto-Timer (aap ki darkhwast par): ab har video ko alag schedule karne ki zaroorat nahi — Upload Manager mein ek dafa waqt set kar dein (khaas date/time, ya 'itne minute baad', ya rozana usi waqt), waqt par tamam queued videos khud-ba-khud ek ke baad ek upload ho jayengi. Countdown screen par nazar ayega, cancel bhi wahi se. Timer ke waqt app khuli honi chahiye; band ho to one-time timer aglay khulne par foran chal jayega aur khabar bhi ayegi.
